Source.Name: tabularis
Source.Summary: Tabularis is a free, open-source desktop database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, and more.
Source.Description: Tabularis is a free, open-source desktop database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, and SQLite. Built with Rust, Tauri,and React. It is fast, lightweight, and designed for everyday SQL work. Brings optional LLM connectivity.
